The Cast of Sea of Love (1989) Then and Now - Updated in 2024

Originally published 21 June 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Cast Then & Now1980s

Sea of Love, the gripping 1989 crime thriller starring Al Pacino and Ellen Barkin, captivated audiences with its suspenseful plot and stellar performances. As we approach the 35th anniversary of this classic film, let's catch up with the talented cast and see where their careers have taken them in 2024.

Quick Glance at the Cast Ages Then and Now

  • Al Pacino: 49 in 1989, 83 now
  • Ellen Barkin: 35 in 1989, 69 now
  • John Goodman: 37 in 1989, 71 now
  • Michael Rooker: 34 in 1989, 68 now
  • William Hickey: 62 in 1989, passed away at 69 in 1997
  • Richard Jenkins: 42 in 1989, 76 now
  • Paul Calderon: 30 in 1989, 64 now
  • John Spencer: 42 in 1989, passed away at 58 in 2005
  • Michael O'Neill: 38 in 1989, 72 now
  • Christine Estabrook: 37 in 1989, 71 now
  • Samuel L. Jackson: 41 in 1989, 74 now

Al Pacino (Detective Frank Keller)

Advertisement

Al Pacino was 49 years old when Sea of Love was released. In 2024, he is 83 years old. Pacino's illustrious career includes iconic roles in The Godfather trilogy, Scarface, Dog Day Afternoon, Serpico, and Scent of a Woman. His accolades include an Oscar, two Emmys, two Tonys, and four Golden Globes.

Recent projects:

  • The Irishman (2019)
  • Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019)
  • Hunters (TV series, 2020-2023)

Ellen Barkin (Helen Cruger)

Ellen Barkin was 35 years old during the filming of Sea of Love. In 2024, she is 69 years old. Barkin is renowned for her roles in Diner, The Big Easy, Switch, and Ocean's Thirteen. She has won an Emmy and a Golden Globe.

Recent projects:

  • Animal Kingdom (TV series, 2016-2022)
  • The Man from Toronto (2022)
  • Poker Face (TV series, 2023)

John Goodman (Detective Sherman Touhey)

John Goodman was 37 years old when Sea of Love hit theatres. In 2024, he is 71 years old. Goodman is well-known for his roles in Roseanne, Barton Fink, The Big Lebowski, Monsters Inc., and Argo. He has won a Golden Globe and an Emmy.

Recent projects:

  • The Righteous Gemstones (TV series, 2019-present)
  • The Conners (TV series, 2018-present)
  • Monsters at Work (TV series, 2021-present)

Michael Rooker (Terry Cruger)

Michael Rooker was 34 years old during the filming of Sea of Love. In 2024, he is 68 years old. Rooker is known for his roles in Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer, Cliffhanger, Guardians of the Galaxy, and The Walking Dead.

Recent projects:

  • Love and Monsters (2020)
  • F9: The Fast Saga (2021)
  • The Suicide Squad (2021)
  • Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023)

Other Cast Members

William Hickey (Frank Keller Sr.)

William Hickey was 62 years old when Sea of Love was released. He passed away in 1997 at the age of 69. Hickey was known for his roles in Prizzi's Honor, National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation, and The Nightmare Before Christmas.

Richard Jenkins (Detective Gruber)

Richard Jenkins was 42 years old in Sea of Love. In 2024, he is 76 years old. Jenkins has appeared in Six Feet Under, The Visitor, Step Brothers, and The Shape of Water.

Recent projects:

  • The Humans (2021)
  • Nightmare Alley (2021)
  • Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story (TV series, 2022)

Paul Calderon (Serafino)

Paul Calderon was 30 years old in Sea of Love. In 2024, he is 64 years old. Calderon is known for his roles in Pulp Fiction, King of New York, and Out of Sight.

Recent projects:

  • Fear the Walking Dead (TV series, 2019-2021)
  • Bosch (TV series, 2014-2021)
  • East New York (TV series, 2022-2023)

John Spencer as Precinct Chief.

  • Spencer was born on December 20, 1946, making him 42 years old when the film was released. He would sadly pass away on December 16, 2005, at the age of 58. He was well known for his roles in L.A. Law, Cop Land, The West Wing, and The Rock. He won an Emmy and four Screen Actors Guild Awards during his career.

Michael O’Neill plays Raymond Brown.

  • O’Neill was born on May 29, 1951, making him 38 years old when the film was released. He is currently 72 years old in 2024. He is well known for his roles in Dallas Buyers Club, Transformers, Grey’s Anatomy, and The Resident. He has been nominated for a Screen Actors Guild Award. He is still active as an actor and has recently appeared in the TV series Echoes and SWAT. Most recently appearing in Ben Affleck's sports docu-drama, Air.

Christine Estabrook plays Gina Gallagher.

  • Estabrook was born on September 13, 1952, making her 37 years old when the film was released. she is 71 years old in 2024. She is well known for her roles in The Usual Suspects, American Horror Story, Desperate Housewives, and Mad Men. She has been nominated for a Drama Desk Award. She is still active as an actress and has recently appeared in the TV shows Designated Survivor, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, and most recently, the latest installment of Penny Dreadful.

Samuel L. Jackson appeared in a minor role in the film.

Born in December 1948, Jackson was 41 years old when the film was released. He will be 74 years old in 2024. It wasn’t until his role in 1993’s Jurassic Park that people started to notice him; the following year, he appeared in Tarantino’s 1994’s Pulp Fiction as Jules, and a megastar was born.

Key Takeaways

  • The main cast of Sea of Love has continued to have successful careers in film and television.
  • Many cast members have won prestigious awards for their performances over the years.
  • Several actors from the film are still active in the industry, taking on new and challenging roles well into their 60s and 70s.
  • The film remains a notable entry in the crime thriller genre, showcasing the talents of its ensemble cast.

FAQ

  • What is Sea of Love about? Sea of Love is a 1989 thriller starring Al Pacino as a detective investigating a series of murders linked to personal ads, with Ellen Barkin playing a potential suspect and love interest.
  • How was Sea of Love received by critics? The film received positive reviews, with praise for its suspenseful plot and strong performances, especially by Al Pacino.
  • How did Sea of Love perform at the box office? Sea of Love was a commercial success, grossing over $110 million worldwide.
  • What ratings did Sea of Love receive? The film holds a 77% rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a 6.8/10 on IMDb, reflecting generally favourable reviews.
  • Did Sea of Love win any awards or appear on notable lists? While it didn't win major awards, it has been recognized in lists of notable thriller films from the 1980s.
  • Are there any famous scenes or quotes from Sea of Love? One of the most memorable scenes is the suspenseful climax, and a notable quote is Al Pacino's line, "There's a lot of ways to lose your life."

The legacy of Sea of Love continues to endure, serving as a testament to the exceptional talent that graced the silver screen in 1989. While the exact updates on cast members may vary, their contributions to the film industry and their lasting impact on audiences are undeniable. It's always a pleasure to reminisce about these accomplished individuals and to recognise the brilliance they brought to the big screen.
